text.body:
vasudevasutaṃ devaṃ kaṃsacāṇūra mardanaṃ | devakīparamānaṃdaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vaṃde jagadgurūṃ || 1 ||
atasīpuṣpasaṃkāśaṃ hāranūpura śobhitaṃ | ratnakaṃkaṇa keyūraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vaṃde jagadgurūṃ || 2 ||
kuṭilālaka saṃyuktaṃ pūrṇacaṃdra nibhānanaṃ | vilasatkuṃḍaladharaṃ devaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vaṃde jagadgurūṃ || 3 ||
maṃdāragaṃdha saṃyuktaṃ cāruhāsaṃ caturbhujaṃ | bahirpiṃchāva cūḍāṃgaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vaṃde jagadgurūṃ || 4 ||
utphullapadma patrākṣaṃ nīlajīmūta sannibhaṃ | yādavānāṃ śiroratnaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vaṃde jagadgurūṃ || 5 ||
rukmiṇīkeli saṃyuktaṃ pītāṃbaraṃ suśobhitaṃ | avāpta tulasīgaṃdhaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vaṃde jagadgurūṃ || 6 ||
gopikānāṃ kucadvaṃdaṃ kuṃkumāṃkita vakṣasaṃ | śrīniketaṃ maheṣvāsaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vaṃde jagadgurūṃ || 7 ||
śrīvatsāṃkaṃ mahoraskaṃ vanamālā virājitaṃ | śaṃkhacakradharaṃ devaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vaṃde jagadgurūṃ || 8 ||
kṛṣṇāṣṭakamidaṃ prātarutthāya yaḥ paṭhet | koṭijanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ smaraṇena vinaśyati ||
phalaśruti ||
|| śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
